definitions.address: street address (contains a house number or street) and ≥ 1 cited source
definitions.location: pin precision exact or building (street-level pins are approximate)
definitions.status: closure recorded, or checked ≤ 365 days ago AND the record carries a live operating signal (opening hours, contact channel or delivery link) — a listicle mention alone does not confirm the business is operating
definitions.contact: phone, website, social page or a delivery/booking link
definitions.menu: a menu/service list: ≥ 1 link evidenced by an official menu, delivery listing or menu photo, or ≥ 5 real dish/item links (one listicle dish mention is not a menu)
definitions.prices: ≥ 1 real dish/item link with a published price
definitions.photo: ≥ 1 real photo of the business (data/venue-photos.json), not an illustration
